name: Ordering at a Restaurant
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on ordering at a restaurant — practice these key phrases out loud:
Could I see the menu, please?
I'll have the grilled salmon, please.
Could I get that without onions?
Could we get the check, please?
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
